title: Application of Boston Edison Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164 App., §§ 2-1 through 2-10 and 220 C.M.R. §§ 7.00 et seq. , for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of the Company's proposed operating budget and applicable monthly surcharge for the Residential Energy Conservation Service program for fiscal year 1995 (July 1, 1994 through June 30, 1995).
